newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - DECEMBER 17.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - DECEMBER 17.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was at 7.1 million zlotys on Tuesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 1,100 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on February 12, 1998 traded at 96.6 zlotys.
* 5,800 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 traded at 79.9 zlotys.
* 9,000 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on February 6, 1999 traded at 100.8 zlotys.
